# Vendored astcenc

Arm astc-encoder, commit `9fbec68053d507023bb30e2a449f900a915882b9`
(reports version 5.7.0), from https://github.com/ARM-software/astc-encoder.
Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE.txt` and notices in `Source/ThirdParty`.

Unmodified build subset: upstream `Source/`, `CMakeLists.txt`, `README.md` and license.
Orbital enables the native CLI only with `ORBITAL_BUILD_TEXTURE_TOOLS=ON`; it is an
offline executable dependency, not a runtime library dependency.
